usage: kathara wipe [-h] [-f] [-s | -a]

Delete all Kathara devices and collision domains, optionally also delete
settings

options:
  -h, --help      Show a help message and exit.
  -f, --force     Force the wipe.
  -s, --settings  Wipe the stored settings of the current user.
  -a, --all       Wipe all Kathara devices and collision domains of all users.
                  MUST BE ROOT FOR THIS OPTION.

For examples and further information visit:
https://github.com/KatharaFramework/Kathara/wiki
